name: Weight masking
description: Disable selected weights without changing tensor dimensions.

name: Individual weight pruning
description: Permanently remove or zero selected low-importance connections.

name: Weight clipping
description: Restrict selected parameters to specified value ranges.

name: Weight rescaling
description: Adjust individual parameter groups or projection magnitudes.

name: Weight transplantation
description: Copy selected compatible weight tensors between models.

name: Neuron masking
description: Disable specific neurons in an MLP or feed-forward network.

name: Neuron pruning
description: Remove neurons and adjust connected weight matrices.

name: Neuron replacement
description: Substitute selected neurons with newly initialized or transplanted units.

name: Channel reorganization
description: Reorder or remap hidden channels while preserving compatible connectivity.

name: Hidden-dimension resizing
description: Expand or contract intermediate representation dimensions.

name: Attention head masking
description: Disable selected attention heads.

name: Attention head pruning
description: Remove heads and adjust attention output projections.

name: Head regrouping
description: Convert or reorganize MHA heads into GQA-style groups.

name: Attention-pattern replacement
description: Replace global attention patterns with local, sliding-window, or sparse patterns.

name: Attention algorithm replacement
description: Substitute softmax attention with linear attention or another attention formulation.

name: Activation replacement
description: Change an FFN activation, such as GELU to SiLU.

name: Gated-FFN conversion
description: Convert a conventional FFN into SwiGLU or another gated structure.

name: Expert pruning
description: Remove selected experts from an MoE layer.

name: Expert transplantation
description: Insert, replace, or merge compatible expert networks.

name: Dense-to-MoE conversion
description: Replace dense FFN layers with routed expert networks.

name: Layer masking
description: Bypass selected layers without permanently deleting their weights.

name: Layer pruning
description: Permanently remove complete neural network layers.

name: Layer duplication
description: Clone existing layers to increase model depth.

name: Layer insertion
description: Introduce new layers into an existing model.

name: Layer transplantation
description: Replace complete layers with compatible layers from another model.

name: Normalization-block replacement
description: Replace LayerNorm with RMSNorm or another normalization structure.

name: Feed-forward-block replacement
description: Replace an entire FFN subsystem with a different computation block.

name: Attention-block replacement
description: Replace a complete self-attention block while retaining surrounding layers.

name: State-space-block transplantation
description: Replace selected Transformer attention blocks with Mamba or SSM blocks.

name: Hybrid-block construction
description: Combine attention, state-space, or convolutional mechanisms within a new composite block.

name: Residual-path restructuring
description: Modify skip connections and residual computation pathways.

name: Layer-order restructuring
description: Change the ordering of attention, FFN, and normalization components.

name: Parallel-branch restructuring
description: Convert sequential processing into parallel computational branches.

name: Cross-layer connectivity surgery
description: Introduce or remove connections across nonadjacent layers.

name: Hierarchical network restructuring
description: Reorganize layers into stages, hierarchies, or multi-resolution processing pathways.

name: Selective backbone substitution
description: Replace a small subset of backbone blocks with a different architectural family.

name: Interleaved hybrid backbone
description: Alternate Transformer layers with Mamba, convolutional, or other blocks throughout the network.

name: Majority backbone replacement
description: Replace more than half of the backbone blocks with a different architecture.

name: Near-total backbone replacement
description: Replace nearly all original backbone blocks while retaining selected original modules.

name: Complete backbone transplantation
description: Replace the entire computational backbone while retaining compatible input/output components.

name: Attention-to-state-space conversion
description: Convert a Transformer-centered architecture toward a predominantly SSM-based architecture.

name: Dense-to-sparse architecture conversion
description: Convert a predominantly dense backbone to a sparsely activated architecture, including MoE structures.

name: Decoder-only to encoder-decoder conversion
description: Restructure a causal-only network into separate encoding and decoding subsystems.

name: Autoregressive-to-diffusion conversion
description: Adapt a model from next-token prediction to iterative denoising generation.

name: Cross-family architecture conversion
description: Transform one major neural architecture family into another while systematically preserving reusable weights or representations.

name: Architecture-guided reconstruction
description: Build a new architecture using the original model's dimensions, organization, or compatible components as references.

name: Partial weight reconstruction
description: Initialize a new architecture from mapped, factorized, or transformed subsets of existing weights.

name: Representation-guided reconstruction
description: Train a substantially new architecture to reproduce internal representations of the original model.

name: Teacher-student architecture replacement
description: Train a different student architecture through knowledge distillation from the original model.

name: Full architectural reimplementation
description: Design and train a new architecture with little or no direct weight reuse, potentially transferring behavior or knowledge from the original system.
